bio.text: Steve Daines is a U.S. Senator from Montana; he was elected to Montana's seat in the U.S. House in 2012 before moving to the Senate.
He grew up in Bozeman, graduated from Montana State University with a B.S. in chemical engineering, and spent thirteen years with Procter & Gamble.
He later worked at a family construction business and was a vice president at RightNow Technologies, a Bozeman software company.
